description: Worker-side reconciliation output (GROSS, pre-deduction). Emitted by a Reconciliation Run and consumed by payroll (P-192); queried by rec_run, not a child row. Carries the day-rate basis snapshot compared against the paired Billable Line by the BASIS-CONSISTENT guard. A partial month is never silent: rec_partial_reason is always set.

fields.description: The worker this gross line pays (internal PII).
fields.label: Worker

fields.description: Payable days for the worker this period.
fields.label: Payable Days

fields.description: Why the month is full or partial. A partial payout is never silent: a non-full reason must be chosen deliberately.
fields.label: Partial Reason

fields.description: Worker monthly package (runtime; from P-189 and the Worker master).
fields.label: Monthly Package

fields.description: Prorated GROSS, pre-deduction (computed at runtime). Deductions are never applied here.
fields.label: Prorated Gross

fields.description: Day-rate basis snapshot (A1). Compared against the paired Billable Line by the BASIS-CONSISTENT guard; a mismatch halts the run.
fields.label: Day Rate Basis Applied

fields.description: Provenance link to the P-189 Rate Resolution that priced this worker; also the pairing key for the BASIS-CONSISTENT guard.
fields.label: Resolution Reference

name: Payable Line
